cases.notes: Whitespace/ellipsis-only source has no alphanumeric content, so the model's [[EMPTY]] sentinel is accepted as a genuinely empty (not fallback) result.
English hesitation-only speech ('um uh erm') carries no meaningful content, so the model's [[EMPTY]] sentinel is accepted as a genuinely empty (not fallback) result.
German hesitation-only speech ('ähm äh hm') carries no meaningful content, so the model's [[EMPTY]] sentinel is accepted as a genuinely empty (not fallback) result.

The source has real content, so an [[EMPTY]] sentinel — whether a genuine model decision or a malicious/accidental one — is rejected in favor of the raw transcript rather than silently erasing meaningful speech.
German equivalent: the source has real content, so the [[EMPTY]] sentinel is rejected in favor of the raw transcript.

Known tricky case: an arbitrary blank candidate (not the explicit [[EMPTY]] sentinel) is never treated as a deliberate empty signal, even when the source itself is filler-only. This is intentional — only the exact sentinel opts into the empty-result path.
The acronym stoplist (OK/TV/PM/AM) is deliberately not protected, so dropping 'OK' is safe while the real acronym 'API' still must survive.
